title: Parsing Gigabytes of JSON per Second
relevance: Describes the 'vectorized classification' technique using PSHUFB nibble-indexed lookup tables for character classification.

title: simdcsv (friendlymatthew) - CSV parser using vectorized classification
relevance: Uses vqtbl1q_u8 (NEON equivalent of PSHUFB) to classify 16 CSV characters at once, with a perfect lookup table for COMMA/QUOTATION/NEW_LINE/OTHER.

title: simd-csv (medialab) - Specialized Rust CSV readers leveraging SIMD instructions
relevance: Production Rust crate using SIMD for CSV parsing, demonstrating real-world applicability of vectorized character classification.

title: How fast can you parse a CSV file in C#?
relevance: Analysis of CSV parsing performance in .NET, covering the Sep parser's SIMD approach to structural character detection.
